There are five stages of grief. There are also five stages of getting a bad review.
Stage one. Denial. That can't be my customer. I've never even been to that street.
Stage two. Anger. You begin typing.
Stage three. You delete it. You type it again. Meaner. With a thesaurus.
Stage four. Bargaining. You ask your mom to leave five stars. Don't.
Stage five. Acceptance. You write two calm sentences, and you go to bed.
The next customer doesn't read the review. They read your reply. Stage five is the only one that pays.
